name: You Have Served Us Well
summary: Beneath the Slaughtered Lamb, Stormwind's warlocks have secured a refuge. They report to Zardeth of the Black Claw, whose cabal has kept the city guard and curious nobles at bay.

sections.title: A Silence Bought in Shadows
sections.body: Beneath the Slaughtered Lamb, Stormwind's warlocks practice their dark arts, tolerated so far by the authorities. Lord Wishock threatens to expose their hidden studies or bring them to an end. So the coven gives him a tainted draught, and his death preserves their refuge beneath the inn.

sections.title: The Master's Boon
sections.body: Zardeth of the Black Claw hears that Lord Wishock has taken his final drink and judges the danger past. To thank the loyal practitioner who kept the city guard and curious peers at bay, Zardeth sends his sniveling imp servant, Zggi, with a dark token of gratitude.

faq.q: Who is Zardeth of the Black Claw?
faq.answer: Zardeth of the Black Claw is a prominent warlock who secretly operates in Stormwind City. He protects the city's hidden dark casters from discovery by local nobles, using ruthless measures against anyone who investigates their forbidden craft.
Stormwind's hidden warlocks gave Lord Wishock a specially prepared toxic brew. With him dead, his noble house will no longer investigate or disturb the practitioners beneath the city streets.
Zggi is an imp bound to serve Zardeth of the Black Claw. Grudging and covetous, Zggi wants to keep the master's treasures but fears the punishment for defying Zardeth openly.

faq.q: Why was Lord Wishock targeted by the warlocks?
faq.answer: The warlocks targeted Wishock because he threatened to disturb and expose Stormwind's coven. They killed him to protect their work in demonology and shadow magic from interference by the nobility.

faq.q: Where does this quest chain conclude?
aliases: where do i turn in you have served us well
faq.answer: The chain ends with Zggi, near Zardeth of the Black Claw in the warlock sanctum beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.

faq.q: Why is this task restricted strictly to warlocks?
faq.answer: The operation involves cabal politics and unlawful assassination. Only proven warlock disciples are trusted with this lethal subterfuge, keeping the broader Alliance authorities unaware.

angles.text: As a warlock, you learn the ruthless measures Stormwind's coven uses to survive. It kills nosy nobles before they can turn the city guard against it.
As an Alliance member, you live beneath Stormwind's pristine spires and pious devotion. Hidden warlocks kill highborn meddlers to protect their presence.
